subject: Activation kickoff & infra constraints — Hearthly Health
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation kickoff & infra constraints — Hearthly Health

Team — quick summary and asks so we can hand this to CS: 

Summary (deal): Hearthly Health (prospect) signed a Dedicated capacity contract last week; committed start date 2025-11-01 for pilot (50 vCPU-equivalent throughput, expected peak 150 qps rewrite during batch windows). ACV includes Redwood Dedicated + Optimize add-on, deal id HLTH-2025-0892.

Customer expectations / constraints flagged during sales: 
- Data residency: US-only (they will require hosting in us-east region)
- Security: SOC 2 type II evidence required (they asked for specific items)
- KMS/HSM: they plan to integrate with their KMS; will need key wrapping and an audit trail
- Network: private peering preferred; they asked for a simple network diagram and port list
- SLA: pilot to run in a fenced capacity with predictable latency SLOs; expected p99 < 450ms for 512-token generations

Attachments: SOW draft + current network diagram stub attached. (See SOW_draft_20250914.pdf, redwood_network_requirements.png)

Asks for CS/PM: 
1) Can we assign a primary CS owner and a technical onboarding lead by Wed 9/17?
2) High-level implementation plan: are the 6-week timelines (sandbox → staging → pilot) reasonable for this footprint?
3) Known blockers for Dedicated (VPC peering, KMS integration, SOC evidence delivery) — please call out any items that need legal/security involvement sooner.

Notes for internal ops: the customer will want a single point of contact for scheduling compliance calls. Procurement contact is Maya Patel (CCed in the thread once she replies).

Next steps I propose: assign owners → schedule 30-min alignment with customer + procurement → deliver technical intake (network/KMS) within 5 business days.

Thanks — happy to sync live if helpful.

— Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0191

[Attachment: SOW_draft_20250914.pdf (application/pdf, 312KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_network_requirements.png (image/png, 78KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation kickoff & infra constraints — Hearthly Health

Thanks Ava — tagging in.

High-level reactions: 6-week sandbox→staging→pilot is aggressive but doable if we get network peering + KMS access within the first two weeks. Primary concerns to surface now: 
- KMS/HSM integration: we'll need a sample key wrapping flow and an integration window; does procurement require a specific HSM vendor?
- SOC2 artifacts: Legal/Security typically needs 5–7 business days to validate customer questions and produce redacted artifacts; if they need original evidence, that stretches timelines.
- Capacity sizing: want to confirm expected token lengths and concurrency distribution — sales estimate above is helpful, but need sample traffic profile.

Requests from CS: 
- Customer tech contact for networking and security (name + email + Slack/phone)
- Access to a non-prod dataset or representative prompt set for evals (even synthetic)

I'll tentatively volunteer as primary CS lead for implementation, with Ben as AE escalation and Tessa as project sponsor. If that works, I'll draft a kickoff plan (two-week intake + 4-week implementation schedule) and share.

Karthik
Principal Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Maya Patel <maya@hearthly.health>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@hearthly.health
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Activation kickoff & infra constraints — Hearthly Health

Hi Ava — thanks for the summary. A couple points from procurement & engineering: 

- Procurement: we attached our standard security & procurement questionnaire. We need SOC 2 type II report and a list of sub-processors. Our finance team will push the PO after we have those items resolved. (Attachment: Heathly_Procurement_Questionnaire_20250916.pdf)

- Engineering: we'll own KMS keys; we use AWS KMS in us-east-1 and prefer a customer-managed key. For network we prefer AWS PrivateLink if Redwood supports it; otherwise we'll do VPC peering. We can provide a network engineer to coordinate.

- Timeline: Hearthly would like a soft pilot start by Nov 1. If legal/procurement causes delay we'd ask for a short pilot waiver window.

Technical contact: Maya Patel (me) for procurement questions; primary eng contact is Noah Ramirez <noah.ramirez@hearthly.health> (cc'd on the questionnaire).

Let me know if you want to set a call this week to walk the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement | Hearthly Health
maya@hearthly.health

[Attachment: Heathly_Procurement_Questionnaire_20250916.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation kickoff & infra constraints — Hearthly Health

Thanks Karthik and Ava — good context. Assigning owners and immediate plan below.

Owner assignment: 
- Primary CS Lead: Karthik Iyer (implementation owner)
- Technical Onboarding Lead: Noah Ramirez (customer) + assigned Redwood SE: Karthik will nominate an SE after intake
- AE Escalation / Exec Sponsor: Ben Carter
- Project Sponsor (internal): Tessa Morgan

Initial intake plan (this week): 
1) Karthik to send customer intake questionnaire and a short Slack/Zoom invite for a 60-min intake call (network + KMS + security) — target by 2025-09-19.
2) Legal/Security to pre-review the procurement questionnaire and pull SOC2 artifacts — Karthik to flag required items by 2025-09-20.
3) Redwood SE to produce a one-page network diagram template and port matrix for VPC peering / PrivateLink by 2025-09-22.

Risks / blockers: 
- If procurement requires onsite audits or non‑standard redactions, timeline could slip 2–3 weeks.
- PrivateLink integration may require product engagement — tagging product if that becomes the path.

Ben — confirm if you'd like to lead the PO escalation path once procurement confirms items.

I'll add these owners to the shared board and create a short milestone checklist. Karthik, you can use the SOW draft Ava shared as the starting point; please keep the pilot acceptance criteria tight (sample queries + latency bounds).

— Tessa

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Activation kickoff & infra constraints — Hearthly Health

Great — thanks everyone for the quick alignment. Confirming next steps & owners (short):
- Karthik: primary CS lead — send intake questionnaire + propose Fri 9/19 10:00am PT for 60-min technical kickoff with Noah + Maya.
- Tessa: internal project sponsor & milestone owner.
- Ben: AE escalation / PO follow-up once procurement confirms SOC2 items.

Ava's immediate asks to Karthik: please add the following to the intake doc: sample concurrency distribution, expected average token length (in tokens), and a list of non-prod datasets or synthetic prompt samples. Also include a checkbox for KMS vendor + PrivateLink vs VPC peering preference.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once Karthik proposes times. If anyone needs me to join the procurement call for clarifications, I can be there.

Action items (owner -> due):
- Karthik: intake doc + meeting slot (due 2025-09-19)
- Customer (Maya/Noah): confirm network contact and procurement timeline (ASAP)
- Security/Legal (internal): pre-review questionnaire (by 2025-09-20)
- SE: network diagram template (by 2025-09-22)

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.

— Ava

[Calendar: tentative technical kickoff to be scheduled]
